name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – National Finals
short_description: A multi-distance race (5K to full marathon) organized by Runrio, set for November 8, 2026 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – National Finals is a road race organized by Runrio, scheduled for November 8, 2026, at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines. It offers four distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Registration details have not yet been announced.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia)

pros: An eight-hour marathon cut-off: all 1,399 marathon finishers in 2025 were inside it
A built-in progression: the 16K, 21K and 32K series legs lead up to the 42K
Series legs can be run in different host cities
The 5K, 10K and 21K at the finals are open to everyone
Full results for every distance are published
cons: The 42K is open only to runners registered for all three long series legs
The 2025 finals were cancelled on their original date for weather and rerun four weeks later
Entry fees are non-refundable and cannot be deferred or transferred
Processing, web and delivery fees are added to the published entry fee

faqs.question: When is the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – National Finals?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on November 8, 2026. This date marks the National Finals event of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, organized by Runrio, and will be held at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, Philippines.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a 21 km half marathon, a 10 km run, and a 5 km run. This range allows both competitive and casual runners to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The event takes place at SM Mall of Asia, located in Pasay City, Philippines. This well-known mall complex serves as the venue for the National Finals of the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 series.

faqs.question: Is registration open yet for this event?
faqs.answer: According to the available information, registration for the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – National Finals has not yet been announced. Prospective participants should watch for updates from the organizer, Runrio, regarding sign-up details and deadlines.
